steps.name: Step 1 — Navigate to the Artifacts section
Step 2 — Select the bucket containing sample.md
Steps 3-6 — Click the upload icon (native file explorer opens immediately), select sample.md, confirm; the 'Upload files to ...' modal opens with the Path field pre-filled
Step 8 — Verify the 'Resolve duplicates' modal opens with the exact singular-form message text, and that detection was purely client-side (zero network requests)
